alate: Head blackish brown, pronotum brown, meso- and metanotum yellowish brown, abdominal tergites the same colour as the pronotum, sternites paler; the intersegmental membrane between the tergites and the sternites densely covered with fine hairs; legs yellowish brown, wings brown. Compound eyes large and protruding, black, elongate-oval; ocelli oval, situated on the inner side of the compound eyes; fontanelle between the two compound eyes, a pale Y-shaped patch. Antennae with 15 segments, the third shortest, the second slightly longer than the fourth, the fourth again slightly longer than the fifth. Anterior margin of the pronotum slightly depressed in the middle, the posterior margin narrower, with a notch in the middle. Forewing: the anterior margin formed by the subcosta and a section of the radius, the radial sector closely appressed behind it, media arising independently at the basal suture and dividing into four branches; the radial sector and the media widely separated, with indistinct fine reticulate veins between them; the cubitus closer to the media, with 8–9 branches. Hindwing: media arising from the radial sector, the rest of the venation similar to that of the forewing; wing hairs short and small.
distribution: Longquan, Zhejiang; Pingnan, Fujian, 850 m above sea level.
soldier: Head yellow, nasus deep brown, thoracic nota pale yellow, abdomen greyish white. The dorsum of the abdomen with a covering of short hairs, the fine hairs of the ventral surface longer. Head longer than wide, narrower at the anterior third and constricted there; nasus longer than half the length of the head, with a longitudinal ridge in the middle of its dorsum extending backwards to the middle of the head; in profile slightly concave between the nasus and the dorsum of the head. Antennae with 13 segments, the fourth shortest, the third and fifth about equal in length. Pronotum rather narrow, only about half as wide as the head, its anterior and posterior parts meeting almost at a right angle; abdomen broader than the head. Small soldier: head pale yellow, nasus pale, chaetotaxy as in the large soldier; antennae with 12 segments, the third shortest, the second and fourth about equal in length.
taxonomy_note: The genus name in the original work is spelt Ahmadite; it is now assigned to the genus Ahmaditermes.
